phases.name: Introduction
phases.description: Introduction to the serious game mechanics and environment
phases.phase_introduction: Somewhere behind Lindenmarkt's actual supply chain sits a honey vault, watched over by a bear who would rather be asleep and audited by a man who trusts nobody, least of all a dashboard.

phases.name: Requirement Engineering
phases.description: Business goal definition and stakeholder alignment
phases.phase_introduction: Management has signed off the budget and the first release date. The team now has to turn better availability and less waste into numbers the system can be measured against.

phases.name: Data Engineering
phases.description: Dataset preparation, addressing data quality, accessibility, and privacy.
phases.phase_introduction: With the goals agreed, the team has access to the till scan lines, the promotion calendar and the supplier master data. The first extracts have landed, and what came back is not as clean as the kickoff slides promised.

phases.name: Model Engineering
phases.description: Design, training, and evaluation of ML models.
phases.phase_introduction: The first labelled demand snapshots are ready. The data science side has taken over the environment to find a model that can forecast fourteen days ahead for every article in every store.

phases.name: Model Deployment
phases.description: Integration of models into production systems.
phases.phase_introduction: The forecast model beat the old planning rules on last season's numbers. Engineering now has to get it into the nightly run and in front of store managers before the next promotion week.

phases.name: Monitoring/ Usage
phases.phase_introduction: The forecast has been driving order suggestions for several weeks. Availability, waste and how often store managers override the suggestion are now the numbers everyone watches.

challenges.name: The Committed Pallets
challenges.description: A supplier has confirmed a bulk order for a middle aisle promotion that ships next week, leaving no room for model error. #requirements_reuben# insists the acceptance criteria must be fully governed to guarantee the allocation logic is auditable before the trucks leave. #reliability_ruth# argues the criteria are sufficient as manual checks because the physical stock is already committed and the team needs to ship the feature immediately to handle the live orders.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The middle aisle category team locked the promotion calendar for the upcoming week, and the supplier confirmed the pallets are on the dock. The nightly forecast job is running, but the allocation module has no formal sign off for this specific high risk scenario.

on_enter_ops.reason: The team paused the sign off process to rush the supplier data integration for the locked promotion week

stalemate_ops.reason: Without agreed criteria, the risk review was abandoned and the allocation logic went live without validation

challenges.name: The Cost Cliff
challenges.description: The infrastructure bill for the monitoring stack has doubled, and #efficiency_emilia# has drawn a hard line: she will not fund automated drift monitoring, insisting it is a luxury the business cannot afford. #reliability_ruth# argues that without automated and governed drift checks, the team is flying blind during promotion weeks, and she refuses to accept a manual process as a substitute for reliable signal.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The finance team flagged that the cost of running the observability pipeline is spiking due to the volume of scan lines from 1200 stores. #efficiency_emilia# has proposed cutting the automated drift monitoring budget to zero to save costs, while #reliability_ruth# warns that this will leave the forecast vulnerable to silent failures during the next promotion cycle.

on_enter_ops.reason: budget freeze on automated monitoring tools

stalemate_ops.reason: data pipeline to drift monitor disconnected due to cost

challenges.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenges.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The nightly forecast job completed, but store managers in the northern region reported significant overstock of cold weather items and stockouts of iced tea. The team needs to decide how to handle the evaluation of a potential model update that incorporates the new weather data.

on_enter_ops.reason: The evaluation scripts failed to parse the new weather feed format, halting all model validation.

stalemate_ops.reason: Without an agreed evaluation path, the pipeline link between training and testing was disabled to prevent unverified models from progressing.

challenges.name: The Honey Vault Standoff
challenges.description: Somewhere behind Lindenmarkt's real supply chain sits a honey vault nobody remembers commissioning. #bear_bruce# wants its data ingestion fully automated so he can go back to hibernating, while #mohawk_mark# refuses to let a pipeline replace him without a fight. #mohawk_mark# might accept an automated solution, provided he personally gets to spot check it first.
challenges.roundIntroduction: You've been handed the file on Lindenmarkt's honey vault, and asked to settle why Bruce and Mark can't agree on how its feed gets collected. Read the room, then figure out who's actually right.

on_enter_ops.reason: The nightly pull from the vault's sensors quietly stopped, and nobody noticed until the numbers stopped moving.

stalemate_ops.reason: Without a working feed, the vault's checks keep running on whatever arrived last, which is an increasingly small set of numbers.

challenges.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenges.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The compliance team suspended access to the loyalty app basket feed after discovering that retention policies were not documented in the data contracts. The KPI definitions for the next promotion cycle were never formally agreed upon, leaving the team without a clear baseline for how to handle the missing personal data signals.

on_enter_ops.reason: compliance audit found missing consent fields in the schema

stalemate_ops.reason: legal team blocked KPI sign off due to unresolved data rights

challenges.name: The Consent Gap
challenges.description: A new model version requires loyalty basket data, but the deployment pipeline lacks the governance controls to verify consent. #automation_alex# wants to push the automated deployment forward immediately to meet the promotion deadline, while #requirements_reuben# insists on a manual review process to ensure legal compliance. #automation_alex# is open to adding a manual approval step if it keeps the pipeline moving, but #requirements_reuben# will not accept any automated path without full audit trails.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The nightly forecast job failed to deploy because the new model version was rejected during the pre-deployment check. The rejection was triggered by a missing consent validation flag for the loyalty data features used in the model.

on_enter_ops.reason: The deployment pipeline was halted after a compliance audit flagged the use of loyalty data without verified consent.

stalemate_ops.reason: The canary testing infrastructure was disabled to prevent any unverified model from reaching a subset of stores.

challenges.name: The Midnight Deadline
challenges.description: The nightly data job is failing to finish before the store managers open the ordering app. #reliability_ruth# demands an automated validation layer to catch bad data instantly so the morning window is never missed again. #data_dave# insists on keeping the process manual for now, arguing that the infrastructure costs are too high and the current manual checks are sufficient to manage the risk.
challenges.roundIntroduction: Last night, the till scan lines arrived late and the validation step was skipped to save time. The forecast job started with incomplete data, causing the morning order suggestions to be wrong for hundreds of stores.

on_enter_ops.reason: The validation service crashed due to resource contention during the peak ingestion window.

stalemate_ops.reason: The link between ingestion and validation is broken, so no data is checked before it reaches the feature store.

challenges.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenges.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.
challenges.roundIntroduction: A recent promotion week saw a spike in overrides after a model update failed to account for a local weather event, leaving store managers skeptical of the system's reliability. The team is now debating how to handle model promotion to restore trust in the forecast.

on_enter_ops.reason: The registry service crashed during a weekly retrain, leaving no record of which model version is currently serving the forecast.

stalemate_ops.reason: Without an agreed promotion path, the link between evaluation and registry is severed, forcing manual handovers that are error prone.

challenges.name: The Locked Shadow
challenges.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The nightly forecast job failed to generate suggestions for the northern stores because the shadow environment was not running. The buyer for the middle aisle promotion has already committed to the supplier, and any delay in validating the new model risks a stockout on the leaflet.

on_enter_ops.reason: The shadow environment was taken offline to free up compute for the promotion allocation run

stalemate_ops.reason: The pipeline step to trigger shadow runs was disabled to prevent further compute costs

challenges.name: The Warehouse Flood
challenges.description: A forecast job failed silently for three days, leaving stores ordering blind, and the team never knew until the warehouse was flooded with unsold promotion stock. #reliability_ruth# argues that the performance monitoring must be automated and governed to catch such failures instantly, while #efficiency_emilia# is willing to accept a manual monthly audit of the logs to save on tooling costs.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The nightly forecast job crashed on a Tuesday night and nobody saw it until the distribution centre reported a spike in manual overrides on Friday morning. The logs show the job died, but the alerting system never fired because the monitoring pipeline was not connected to the alerting service.

on_enter_ops.reason: the connection between performance monitoring and alerting was severed during a recent infrastructure change

stalemate_ops.reason: the monitoring job was disabled to reduce compute costs while the team debated the fix

challenges.name: The Silent Store Gap
challenges.description: A batch of till scan lines from the northern stores was silently dropped during last night's ingestion, causing the model to forecast zero demand for fresh produce. #reliability_ruth# argues that the ingestion pipeline must be fully automated to guarantee every store's data arrives on time, while #data_dave# is willing to accept a manual verification step to ensure data quality before it reaches the feature store.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The nightly store export pipeline failed for a subset of stores without triggering any alerts. The forecast job ran on incomplete data, leading to empty shelves for high demand articles in the affected regions this morning.

on_enter_ops.reason: The nightly batch job crashed due to a schema mismatch in the new store master data.

stalemate_ops.reason: Without a resolution on ingestion reliability, the validation link is disabled to prevent bad data from propagating.
